Message:
“Let’s make our new vow
three days later,
beneath the setting sun.”
That’s what
I promised Fortina then.

And now, that day has come.
But...

A request came in to eliminate
a horde of cursed creatures
running rampant in the forest,

so I set out with Alexandra
and some others to
take care of the situation.

Our destination
was close enough
that we’d likely make it
back before sundown,
yet I couldn’t help
but feel uneasy.

Should Fortina and I
put our plans off
until tomorrow?

It’s an important promise,
meant to tie our
severed bond back together.

No matter the reason,
I must not break it.
I’ll do everything in my power
to keep it...!

“Don’t worry, Fortina.
I will keep my promise.
That’s why I want you to
wait until I come back.”

“Of course.
I will also be praying
for your safe return.”
